description:
At Foxbrim Naturals, we believe life is just better if you look and feel like your best self. Every product that we sell is designed specifically to have as few ingredients as possible, be part of a simple routine, and to achieve the results you deserve.

Hi there!  I'm Luann, co-owner and co-founder of Foxbrim Naturals and I helped start Foxbrim Naturals and I am joined by Chrissa who is best known for creating EASY, healthy, whole food meals and quick, effective workouts for women, while at the same time raising two amazing kids.

How did we get our start?

We are 2 busy moms who were fed up with the traditional toxic skincare options that were being pushed to us, and wanted to create a line that was all-natural, simple to use and effective.

What makes our products unique?

We create plant based skincare that works to treat, repair and nourish skin. We sustainably source our ingredients from around the world, formulate, batch and bottle right here in the USA.

Why do we love what we do?

We love seeing you feeling comfortable and confident showing your true self...so you can be fearless leaving the house without makeup on!

We create all of our products around 3 basic principles:

1. SIMPLE: Create skin and hair care solutions with as few ingredients as possible to get the best results while building beauty regimens that are easy to use.

2. NATURAL: Use natural and organic ingredients that are sustainably sourced and can be used on all skin types.

3. EFFECTIVE: Provide proven formulations and ingredients that deliver results, that bring out our true natural beauty, AND THAT ACTUALLY WORK!

Finally, we work hard to ensure that our ingredients don't harm the earth and are ethically sourced. As a busy mom of three, I feel I owe it to my kids to leave a legacy and world that's better than what I had.

- Our products are produced without parabens, silicones and synthetic fragrance.                                

- We're Certified Cruelty-Free by Leaping Bunny.                                        

- We offer free shipping to the United States on $50+ .                                

- Our AOV is $56. Our current best-seller (and the best entry point) is our Restore Regimen.    

What we can offer for you: 15% commission with a 30 day cookie duration. 

We look forward to working with like-minded affiliates who are passionate about natural skincare like us!
term_and_condition: Payment to Affiliates occurs on 15th and 30th of each month (or closest business day after if falls on a weekend).
